svg.title: Pozool Stays infrastructure
svg.desc: A property manager reaches stays.pozool.com over HTTPS. Kamal proxy routes requests to a Rails web container, which reads and writes its PostgreSQL primary database configuration and renders PDFs with Chromium. Rails sends mail through Porkbun SMTP, errors to Sentry, and logs to Better Stack. Host cron runs scheduled tasks inside the Rails web container. A separate Solid Queue job container uses a PostgreSQL queue database configuration, updates application data, and fetches external iCal feeds. Rails Active Storage uploads originals and documents to separate S3 buckets. An object-created event invokes an AWS Lambda function to read originals and write resized images to a thumbnails bucket. CloudFront reads originals and thumbnails and serves them to the browser. Database host placement is unspecified. The diagram is inferred from repository configuration.
